description: Covers B15, B16, B52. Move the first consumer's console and camera checks out of proxy/tests/test_console.cpp and test_camera.cpp into an <adapter>/tests/ hook that build.sh tests also compiles (B15); build.sh --docker and build_id.py work with the null game inside the core (B16); the null game's viewer/pins.json names only core things and fetch_ui.py validates it against a schema (B52, from the W2 review).
title: The null game builds and tests on its own
